task: Develop a hybrid MARL-LNS algorithm for Multi-Agent Path Finding

method_commitments.phase_1: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (Q-learning) for initial collision reduction
method_commitments.phase_2: Large Neighborhood Search with Prioritized Planning for collision resolution

key_hypothesis: MARL initialization reduces collision density, enabling LNS to resolve remaining conflicts more efficiently
related_work_key_papers: MAPF-LNS2 (Li et al. 2022) - LNS framework for MAPF
PRIMAL (Sartoretti et al. 2019) - MARL for decentralized MAPF
SCRIMP (Wang et al. 2023) - Communication-based MARL for MAPF
limitations_acknowledged: Tabular Q-learning instead of deep neural networks
Random agent generation instead of benchmark configurations
